# Bannerbear

> Bannerbear is an API and no-code platform for automatically generating images, videos and PDFs at scale. It is used for marketing automation, social media visuals, personalized content, e-commerce banners, and dynamic media. Bannerbear also publishes a suite of free, privacy-friendly browser tools that process media entirely on the user's own device (no upload).

## Product
- [Image Generation API](https://www.bannerbear.com/v5/products/image-api/): Auto-generate template-based images for social media, ecommerce and more via API or AI tools.
- [PDF Generation API](https://www.bannerbear.com/v5/products/pdf-api/): Render templates to print-ready PDF and assemble multi-page documents.
- [Animation API](https://www.bannerbear.com/v5/products/animation-api/): Auto-generate animated title cards, product ads and video overlays from templates.
- [Video Generation API](https://www.bannerbear.com/v5/products/video-api/): Process and edit video in the cloud (resize, overlay, AI subtitles, AI voiceover and more).
- [Workflow API](https://www.bannerbear.com/v5/products/workflow-api/): Run multi-step media workflows that chain renders and tools together in the cloud.
- [Pricing](https://www.bannerbear.com/pricing/): Plans and pricing, including a free trial with API credits.
